trials.claim: Platform lets you sell a branded learning experience to unlimited students
trials.claimQuote: OnlineCourseHost.com is an AI-powered course builder that lets you build and sell a branded learning experience to unlimited students.
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises a branded home for courses on your own domain, and the Pro-plan limit and lack of CSV upload do not show a cap on student numbers or that deal buyers cannot brand their school.

exhibits.quote: Yes, our Pro plan and above allows you to use your own domain for your online school.
exhibits.argument: Branded custom-domain experience requires Pro plan or above, not included on all plans.

exhibits.quote: We've been waiting all day for support to upload a list of students who were starting training today, as the platform doesn't allow direct uploads via .csv.
exhibits.argument: Inability to directly bulk-upload students undermines selling to unlimited students at scale.

exhibits.quote: A branded home for your courses on your own domain.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises a branded home for courses on your own domain.

trials.claim: Previous customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased OnlineCourseHost.com can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms they purchased another code and applied it to their existing academy; complaints about needing codes per course or 5GB per code confirm stacking raises limits rather than preventing it.

exhibits.quote: The Biggest Flaw is Only 1 Course Upload with 1 Code of 99$, for every course you need to stack up more code each for 99$.
exhibits.argument: Stacking more codes is required per course, making increased limits expensive rather than freely expandable.

exhibits.quote: Y me responden que son 5 GB por código.
exhibits.argument: Storage is capped at 5GB per code, contradicting unlimited storage expectations when stacking.

exhibits.quote: I was able to purchase another code and apply it to my existing academy.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they could purchase another code and apply it to increase limits.

trials.claim: You can create courses with quizzes, assignments, and downloads
trials.claimQuote: OnlineCourseHost.com lets you create online courses packed with robust media like quizzes, assignments, and downloads.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report they cannot upload documents and can have only one item per lecture, directly limiting the claimed quizzes, assignments, and downloads combined in courses.

exhibits.quote: You cant upload any document and it just in English
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to upload documents, directly contradicting downloads support.

exhibits.quote: but the ability to only have one item per lecture could is not sufficient, as a video, text, quiz etc., preferably could be accompanied by a file, link etc.
exhibits.argument: Only one item per lecture prevents combining video, quiz and files as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Drag-and-drop lessons, quizzes, and drip schedules - no code.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists quizzes as part of the course builder.

exhibits.quote: Upload video, PDFs, and downloads - we handle hosting and streaming
exhibits.argument: Vendor states downloads are supported with hosting and streaming.

trials.claim: AI creator assistant generates a full suite of course content
trials.claimQuote: Use the powerful AI creator assistant to generate a full suite of course content in a record time.
trials.reasoning: A reviewer warns one-click full course generation does not work as implied, and the vendor itself only promises draft outlines, lessons, and quizzes or a first draft, not a full suite.

exhibits.quote: if you´re thinking "i click a button, generate courses, while watching your favorite football game". Think twice.
exhibits.argument: One-click full course generation does not work as implied, requiring substantial manual work.

exhibits.quote: Now a few months ago, AI started to convert published courses to drafts all of a sudden.
exhibits.argument: AI actively breaks published courses instead of reliably generating content.

exhibits.quote: Draft outlines, lessons, and quizzes from a single prompt.
exhibits.argument: Vendor says AI assistant drafts outlines, lessons and quizzes from one prompt.

exhibits.quote: Generate a first draft with the AI assistant, then make it yours
exhibits.argument: Vendor says the AI assistant generates a first draft for the creator.

trials.claim: Chat with AI to brainstorm ideas, rewrite text, and create lesson titles and descriptions
trials.claimQuote: Whip up lesson titles, images, teasers, descriptions, and moreSimply chat with the AI to brainstorm ideas, rewrite text, or fine-tune your message
trials.reasoning: No defense exhibit is shown, and the prosecution exhibits only say the AI guides existing ideas with user effort and give a truncated rejection quote, neither proving nor disproving chat for brainstorming, rewriting, and titles.

exhibits.quote: AI here really does a great job at guiding you through your existing ideas-knowledge, but you still need to invest quality time and make use of that extraordinary brain nature has equipped you with.
exhibits.argument: AI only guides existing ideas and still requires significant user effort, not automatic creation.

exhibits.quote: My course was rejected unless I agree to re-write the whole thing using
exhibits.argument: AI system forces full rewrites and rejects content, undermining free brainstorming and rewriting assistance.
